Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: HelioMed discovery — next engineering deep dive & calendar re-sync

Hi Peter — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

• Summary: Went over HelioMed’s latency and throughput constraints for near-real-time inference, your desire for predictable per-request costs, and the need for audit logs for clinical auditability.
• Open asks from HelioMed: sample throughput numbers for our TGI-optimized runtime, example retention configuration, and network architecture notes for VPC/private deployment.
• Next step (recommended): 60–75 minute engineering deep dive with our infra + applied ML engineer to walk through a short demo (1) performance profiles, (2) KV cache behavior, and (3) integration options for your data plane.

I tried to send a calendar invite from my calendar as we were wrapping up but I’ve seen reports where invites don’t reach some orgs' filters — can you confirm you received the invite? If not, quick options below (times shown in PT / UTC in parentheses):

Option A — Tue May 25, 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC 
Option B — Wed May 26, 13:00 PT / 20:00 UTC 
Option C — Thu May 27, 08:00 PT / 15:00 UTC 

Please tell me which slot works and whether your team prefers CET/UTC times instead (I’ll reissue invites accordingly).

Attached: deep_dive_agenda.pdf — short agenda and prep checklist.

If these windows don’t work, tell us two preferred slots and we’ll adapt. Naomi from AE ops is cc’d to help lock the meeting and share access details.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
